title: fanout_job item (FanOutJob)
description: Fan-out job with incremental counters (DISENO S4 (b)(c); CMD-03). DISENO 'status' is unified as 'state'.
$comment: Table fanout_job (per cell). PK = JOB#<jobId>, SK = META. AP-F6 cancel: UpdateItem cancelRequested=true; AP-F7 progress: GetItem; AP-F8 retry: condition on lastRetryRequestId. Idempotent create: PutItem attribute_not_exists(PK), jobId = publishId for a publish. TTL attribute ttl = TTL_job after the job ends (DISENO 5.1). Streams NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES -> FanOutCompleted.v1 when the job reaches a terminal state (DEC-28).

jobId.description: Job id (= publishId for a publish).

obsolete.description: Tasks OBSOLETE (cancelled, withdrawn version or newer publication).

lastRetryRequestId.description: requestId of the last retry of FAILED tasks (= Idempotency-Key of the operator API or requestId of RetryFanOutTasks.v1); a retry with the same id is a no-op (DEC-35).

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL attribute, epoch seconds. Duration = named parameter TTL_job (no value fixed in the docs). Set when the job reaches a terminal state.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: RUNNING <-> PAUSED (operator API); with no non-terminal task left -> COMPLETED (no FAILED), PARTIAL (some FAILED) or CANCELLED (cancelRequested); PARTIAL -> RUNNING on a retry of FAILED tasks. Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
